Publication Visualization 2.0: reviewed figures and provenance

Source: vignettes/articles/publication-visualization-v2.Rmd
publication-visualization-v2.Rmd

Visualization 2.0 converts supplied 2D/3D trajectories into four journal-oriented plots with exact source-row and QC policy linkage. The example dataset below is synthetic, not measured fish movement.

Journal starting-point presets

The returned journal-style widths and raster DPI are reproducible technical defaults, not a promise of compliance with a named publisher.

~{r setup, include=FALSE} library(aquaTrajectories) knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=TRUE,fig.width=8,fig.height=5, fig.align=“center”,warning=FALSE,message=FALSE) ~

~{r presets} aqt_viz2_presets() ~

One reviewed data source, four native figures

The fish observations include a deliberately missing position and a source-frame discontinuity. Neither can form a movement line segment.

~{r input} time <- 0:12 rows <- do.call(rbind,lapply(1:3,function(i) { x <- .5i + .2time + .15sin(time/2+i) y <- i + .35cos(time/2+i) observed <- !(i==2L & time==5L) data.frame(session_id=“SYNTHETIC”,camera_id=“TOP”, track_id=paste0(“fish”,i),frame_id=time+as.integer(time>=8), time_s=time,x=ifelse(observed,x,NA_real_), y=ifelse(observed,y,NA_real_),observed=observed, source_row=paste0(i,“-”,time)) })) tracks <- aqt_tracks(rows,units=“cm”,coordinate_system=“tank”) qc <- aqt_qc2_report(tracks,gap_limits_s=1.01,speed_limits=2) stopifnot(nrow(qc$lineage)==nrow(rows)) ~

QC-eligible spatial path segments

~{r viz2-paths, fig.alt=“Native observed-position trajectories, broken at missing and excluded steps”} paths <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure=“paths”,policy_id=“QC001”, preset=“journal_double”) aqt_viz2_draw(paths) ~

Only eligible speed measurements

~{r viz2-speed, fig.alt=“Observed speed from only valid source steps”} speed <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure=“speed”,policy_id=“QC001”) aqt_viz2_draw(speed) ~

Source-row coverage

~{r viz2-coverage, fig.alt=“Exact eligible, excluded and nonestimable source-row coverage”} coverage <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure=“qc_coverage”, policy_id=“QC001”) aqt_viz2_draw(coverage) ~

Complete QC reason classification

~{r viz2-reasons, fig.alt=“QC decision reason frequency for original rows”} reasons <- aqt_viz2_spec(qc,figure=“qc_reasons”, policy_id=“QC001”) aqt_viz2_draw(reasons) ~

Transactional source-linked export

The following code creates both vector and raster artwork, plus the input row, eligible-movement and full QC decision evidence. It refuses to overwrite an existing directory.

aqt_viz2_export(paths, "manuscript_figure_1",
                formats=c("pdf","svg","png","tiff"))
stopifnot(aqt_viz2_verify("manuscript_figure_1"))

If the original source file, sealed specification or output file is modified without a new scientific audit, validation fails. All 22 existing public native plotting functions are documented in the complete public plotting gallery.

For scientific and publisher limitations, consult the Publication Visualization 2.0 methods.
